name: cuberhyk-dev-flow
description: A compact Codex lifecycle workflow plugin for repository initialization, validation, orientation, planning, audits, and knowledge distillation.

interface.shortDescription: Init, check, orient, plan, audit, and distill coding work.
interface.longDescription: cuberhyk-dev-flow provides six focused Codex skills: dev-init to bootstrap repository memory, dev-check to validate docs routing, dev-orient to enter repository context without noise, dev-plan to create a minimal verifiable task plan, dev-audit to route structured findings to docs/audits, and dev-distill to turn completed work into durable project knowledge.
defaultPrompt: Use dev-init to initialize Dev Flow memory when needed.
Use dev-check to validate docs routing.
Use dev-orient to enter this repository context.
Use dev-plan to define the next task and persist non-trivial plans.
Use dev-audit to review features or workflows and persist non-trivial findings.
Use dev-distill to preserve durable project knowledge.
